328180c.summary: Returns the TutorialStage asset for the current tutorial/campaign match, or null if the match type has none. Picks the stage from PlayerDataManager (custom scenario, campaign set stage, or tutorial stage index) and loads it through Addressables. The decompiler merged unrelated inlined LINQ helper code into the middle of the body.

A custom scenario set on the player data manager wins over everything else
Otherwise take the current campaign set and the stage index from tips data to find the scenario's stage
No scenario in the current campaign set: no stage

Load the TutorialStage asset through the Addressables manager (reference counted)

328a0e4.summary: Returns the scripted actions to run after a tutorial battle ends: the victory list if isVictory, else the defeat list, from the current tutorial stage. Returns null when the stage has no post-battle script.
comments: Does the current stage define a post-battle script for this outcome?
Fetch the current tutorial stage asset
Victory uses the stage's victory scripted actions, defeat uses the defeat list
No post-battle script: return null
